findings.title: A failed load of the wallet history or payment list shows an empty list
findings.description: useWallet.ts:197 and useAppPayments.ts:25 swallow a failed fetch ('transactions are optional'; 'absent beats wrong'). The screen then reads 'no transactions' — a statement about money that is not true — with nothing reported.

evidence.observation: catch { /* the list is optional; absent beats wrong */ }

findings.root_cause: Optional data treated as absent data.
findings.technical_impact: An outage looks like an empty history.
findings.business_impact: A Pioneer may think a payment is missing.
findings.recommendation: Keep the list optional but distinguish 'could not load' from 'none', and reportError the failure.
acceptance_criteria: A failed history request renders an error state and reports it (test)
